concerns.text: Tasks T060-T068 (Phase 7) address physical invariants, solvent models, and ontological discussions that have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md. The spec only defines US1-US3 (HOMO/LUMO/Mayer, DFT baseline, sensitivity). These tasks constitute unapproved scope creep; either remove them or add corresponding FRs/SCs to spec.md.

Task T062 mandates 'optional' solvent parameter inclusion for DFTB+ to address hydration shells. The spec.md Data Model and US1 input definition (CSV with SMILES, experimental_barrier) provides no mechanism for solvent data. This task is impossible to execute as specified without adding a data source or input field to the spec.

Task T004 references 'FR-001' for data downloading. The spec.md contains no 'FR-001' (it uses User Stories US1-US3 and implicit requirements). This breaks the traceability chain. Either add explicit FRs to spec.md or remove the [FR-001] tag from the task.

Task T042 references 'Curie/Franklin review' standards. The spec.md US2 only requires a paired t-test and MAE threshold. The 'Curie/Franklin' reference is an artifact of the simulated review process not defined in the spec, creating a testability gap. Remove persona references from task descriptions.

Tasks T065 (path-integral diagrams) and T045 (map vs. territory discussion) require philosophical/documentation outputs that do not trace to any FR/SC in spec.md. The spec defines computational outputs (CSVs, reports) but not ontological discussions. These tasks lack requirement coverage.
